title: console: Manage views, view settings and Create View are offered on isAdmin alone, so an org admin without manage_metadata meets a 403
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36409 (PR #36398, only metadata admins share list views). The L1 found it and the PR names it as left untouched. Filed by the seat. Parent: #36409.

## What happens

Manage views, the view settings panel and the Create View dialog in the console are gated on `isAdmin` alone. An organization administrator who lacks `manage_metadata` is offered them, and the server then refuses the write with 403. #36398 moves the Shared gate to `manage_metadata`; these three entries still read the old gate.

## To do

1. Gate the three entries on the same capability the server enforces for the write they lead to, read the way #36398 reads it for the Shared gate.
2. Pin each entry: hidden for an organization administrator without `manage_metadata`, shown with it.

## Acceptance

- An organization administrator without `manage_metadata` is not offered Manage views, the view settings panel or Create View, and so never meets the 403; one with it sees them as today.

Blocked-by: #36398

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui. A user is offered an action the server refuses.
